EU Digital Services Act targets ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox for illegal content

ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox are now subject to stricter regulations under the European Union's Digital Services Act (DSA). The EU has classified ChatGPT as a search engine, a first for an AI chatbot, and designated Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms. These platforms have a four-month deadline to comply with new obligations aimed at mitigating illegal content and ensuring child safety, including addressing negative effects on users' physical and mental well-being.
